reviews.title: A really good airline
reviews.text: I never write reviews but I had to make an exception for Thai Airlines. I have been on so many appalling airlines in the last year (EasyJet, Wizz etc..) who treat their customers with distain, but Thai Airways was fantastic. They departed on time for my flight to Bangkok, connecting flight to Bali, and my return flights home, and had the best service on board even though I was in economy. The crew were smartly dressed, the food on board was good and I enjoyed the online entertainment on the plane. Would without a shadow of a doubt fly Thai Airlines again.
reviews.author: warlord99

reviews.title: BKK-DPS-BKK : Aircraft requires to be upgraded
reviews.text: I flew from BKK-DPS-BKK, firstly there is only one flight per day. So by the time we reach DPS already half of the day is gone. The Thai service is very good, food and beverages are great, but the aircraft is tad old. The seats are not fully reclining and does not give a comfortable sleep even in business class. The other problem is the Inflight entertainment system. Its really old and non-responsive. The content available is also very very limited. I noticed that many people were getting there own media (in Ipad or phones) to entertain themselves.
reviews.author: Parit Gupta

reviews.title: Excellent customer service -lost property
reviews.text: After reading some of the previous reviews, I was a little concerned about flying with Thai airlines but everything was fine- the film choice was a bit limited but the service was friendly and efficient. However the main reason for this review is to thank the staff for all their help when I lost one of my ear pods during the flight. When the plane landed 4 of the cabin crew thoroughly searched the area where I had been sitting -they were incredibly helpful but couldn’t locate it. I reported the item missing to customer service the next day and they emailed straight back to say my ear pod had been found. They then arranged for it to be flown to a nearby airport for me to collect and emailed and phoned to ensure that I knew all the arrangements and had collected it ok -amazing customer service thank you!
reviews.author: jmc21332

reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: We flew Thai Airways again. This time from Bangkok to Osaka by Business class. The check-in was smooth and we enjoy Thai Airways Lounge before departure. The plane was quite new and we enjoy very good service from cabin crew. The seat is quite good, larger than other Thai Airways Business class. We did have some good sleep before landing. The breakfast is quite good and tasty. The flight was smooth and we arrive a little before schedule. Overall we are very satisfied.
reviews.author: Rithee

reviews.title: Good service, nice staff and good food
reviews.text: Good service and reasonably priced airfares. I've flown with them a couple of times between Australia and India and have never faced any issues.
reviews.author: fred

reviews.title: Comfortable flight from Manila to Bangkok!
reviews.text: I have no complaints with this flight other than a 30-minute delayed departure. Check-in was also delayed by a system shut-down in Manila, but the staff were attentive and sympathetic. Boarding was smooth and the plane (787 Dreamliner) was very comfortable. Movie selection was good. Service was prompt and attentive. And the food (I opted for prawns and potatoes) was surprisingly good.
reviews.author: Raintree_Thailand

reviews.title: First Thai flight in more than three years!
reviews.text: After decades of flying Thai, I had a COVID-induced hiatus of more than three years. Glad to see that Thai has so far survived and is trying to re-invent itself as a profitable airline. The service to Manila was typically elegant and professionally staffed and well managed. Food was rather disappointing, but otherwise the flight was OK.
reviews.author: Raintree_Thailand

reviews.title: Poor service on board
reviews.text: We boarded at 2125 and then had our first meal by 2200, which was the good part . 2300 lights out and no service for seven hours . No offer of water even though their on board video says to stay hydrated . Turns out if you can find someone they will give you water . Just thought it was because it was an overnight flight ….but no . Same coming back . 1250 flight , food served within 40 minutes , then nothing for seven hours ! Again you have to go and ask for water etc . Lights out the whole flight . Used to be staff would walk up the aisle every hour offering drinks but no more . Really poor . And actually they got continually pestered by passengers for snacks after four hours ,and drinks so they might as well have offered drinks from the trolley like they used to.
reviews.author: Milesandmiles1

reviews.title: Affordable
reviews.text: We had a bit of a wait for check in. For some reason only 1 of the business class check ins were taking business class passengers. The others were taking economy passengers. After about 15 minutes they seemed to realise the business class line wasn’t moving and started checking in passengers. Flights were on time. In fact due to tail wind we arrived an hour early into Bangkok. Service was good. I had ordered vegetarian. The entree was beautiful but the main of noodles was a bit soggy. Entertainment system isn’t great, not a lot of choice in films or tv series. I was surprised that they only offer one series for each tv series. Given my flight was overnight not a huge issue. First time flying business class with Thai. Well set up with seat and ability to lie down flat. Price wise very reasonable for business class experience.
reviews.author: catmac5373

reviews.title: Very helpfull
reviews.text: I was stuck for 2,5 hours in traffic, so got there 30 min before departure. I called before arriving. They let me take the baggage with me since it was too late to check in. Their service was amazing.
reviews.author: Kunde

reviews.title: Baggage lost! Non existent customer service to assist
reviews.text: I travelled from Melbourne to Hyderabad on 1 June via Bangkok. Only one of my 2 bags was returned. My 25 kg heavier bag which had all my clothes, didn’t make it. It has been really hard to get in touch with anyone from Thai Airways. All the Indian contact numbers for Thai Airways are mostly uncontactable as they are invalid. I even dropped in to their Hyderabad office only to be told that if I drop my email I will be posted with updates. So far no one has contacted me. I have also submitted a claim online for some financial reimbursement as I have to buy new clothes till I get my bag. I haven’t received any email confirmation whether a form was submitted or someone is processing my request. I have even tried to contact Thai Airways Bangkok office but could only get through once where I was told that I should contact Hyderabad airport. Hyderabad airport has been following up and haven’t received any feedback. The whole problem started as someone else’s tag was applied to my bag as a result it only made it to Bangkok and not further. While I can understand that mixups can happen, the complete lack of customer service is very appalling. Thai Airways has been the airline of choice for all these years but my latest experience has made me think about flying with Thai Airways in the future. It’s so far been a nightmare.
reviews.author: shubhankar t

reviews.title: Good Airlines
reviews.text: I purchased the two ticket online and they were offering a discounted rate for a round trip last year. The ground service was good in Dhaka. Good food and entertainment inflight. Crews were good as well.
reviews.author: Dr. Ziauddin Ahmed

reviews.title: Service with a smile
reviews.text: I have been travelling with Thai Airways for over 10 years now. I really like the airlines, its service, its fleet and also its food. I feel a little improvement can be in terms of Entertainment options. I love flying Thai airways
reviews.author: Parit Gupta

reviews.title: Always delay
reviews.text: My first flight to Bangkok was delayed for 45 minutes for no reason. My return flight to HK was delayed for 1h before boarding. After we board on the plane, there seemed to have some problems with the plane (weather was very good), we had been sitting ON THE PLANE for another 2 hours without any explanation. Overall, the plane was delayed for 3h+ without any explanation. Poor airplane quality and poor service as well. I would suggest you choose other airline if you don't want to have delayed flights. (100% delay).
reviews.author: Jess C

reviews.title: Service is outstanding and caring
reviews.text: We travelled from Australia to London Heathrow with Thai airways and are now on our way home. At all times the Thai service was extremely caring and thoughtful. The Flight attendants are impeccably dressed. The food served was excellent. The only negative was the poor choice of movies.
reviews.author: Kate R

reviews.title: Overrated - very poor experience in business
reviews.text: I've been flying back from Melbourne to Frankfurt via Bangkok. 2 Business class flights and same poor experience: very old planes, poor service (flight attendants barely spoke english and create weird situations in interaction with passengers, they smile alot but are neither friendly nor helpful. ) food quality below average for business class (corresponded rather to an economy meal in real high end airlines - especially main dishes were really poor), little choice of wines, outdated entertainment with very limited choice (especially when you are flying in the same day 10 + 13 hours flights)... furthermore at Bangkok airport I've visited 2 lounges and one was extremely old with disgustingly dirty showers. Newer lounge was ok though. It was the first time I was flying Thai airways and based on this disappointing experience I think this airline is truly overrated. Thai airways was perhaps good 2 decades ago but old airplanes/equipment and lack of appropriate service make it in my opinion an under-average option. I will probably avoid it in the future especially for long trips.
reviews.author: touriste_chine

reviews.title: Business Class Singas to Bangkok
reviews.text: What an old fleet stil at Thai Airwaysl. Thank goodness for Kris Business lounge at Changi, Service was good, food good.
reviews.author: Robert B

reviews.title: Unrepresentative of the Amazing Thai Service and Standards
reviews.text: This airline is just simply shoddy. We pre-ordered vegetarian meals and when we got on the flight were told nothing was booked. We were given meat meals and told to ‘pick the meat out of it’. When we complained they got very offended that we didn’t understand their point of view that they ‘didn’t have it logged’. Bizarre! We kept getting dirty looks off the steward the entire flight and continued to be offered meat options. We didn’t eat anything on an 11 hour flight. Not a great start to our honeymoon. Fortunately, we have experienced nothing but amazing service from almost all services in Thailand and its strange how Thai airlines can fall so far short of their fellow countrymen. After the flight we first tried to confirm the vegetarian meals for the flight home and firstly the app said it was confirmed but reset itself. We called customer service who said it hadn’t been logged but confirmed they had done it. Only to later receive a response from customer services in regard to our complaint who said they noticed we hadn’t logged the meals for the return journey so had done it. It seems to just keep resetting itself and they don’t seem to get that. So frustrating and we have no confidence that we will get the meals on the way home. No form of compensation was offered at all. Nothing. Such incredibly poor service and so disappointed.
reviews.author: richardwD1374IS

reviews.title: Pleasant Experience
reviews.text: Our party of 7 recently flew with Thai Airways to Bangkok. Due to scheduling conflicts, we had to reschedule our flight a couple of times and each time, the customer service representative was very accommodating and prompt in assisting us in our requests. On our return, we accidentally left a bag on the plane. I emailed the airline the next morning and they were quick to respond and found my bag within a few hours on the same day. The crew we travelled with were all very friendly and approachable. Overall, we had a pleasant experience and would definitely fly with them again.
reviews.author: Jaclyn

reviews.title: Horrible Customer Service
reviews.text: Very poor response on refund of the ticket. We have been waiting for 5 months and they are saying it will take 6 months. Why it takes 6 months ? Totally unacceptable.
reviews.author: Sal Ak

reviews.title: Really good experience
reviews.text: Really good experience with Thai air. All of the staff were so lovely and helpful, went above and beyond to help me and my wife. The flights were about 12 hours, and we were given two main meals, a snack and regular drinks and water throughout. We are vegan and we were able to get vegetarian Jain meals which were fresh and absolutely delicious, they checked before the flight we were vegan and were given separate meals to the regular service, all very good health meals. The in-flight entertainment was good, nice selection of films and TV. Given pillows and blankets and the flight itself was comfortable. The way to Bangkok was lovely, but I think the way home was a slightly older model of plane so the seats were a bit more uncomfortable with less legroom but still very good nonetheless. I would happily use them again, big thanks to all the staff and crew. No delays with check-in, all very organised and on-time. All the negative reviews are regarding people who had a flight cancelled and have been reimbursed via vouchers, which it clearly says when you buy tickets so this isn't really a shock
reviews.author: HJ1

reviews.title: Dishonest company
reviews.text: Dishonest company that does not reimburse the luggage it has damaged despite the strict observance of the procedure. Do not answer emails or phone calls. This company is completely adrift, it is a shadow of its former self. Travel on board a 777 totally tired and faded. Lousy performances and limited service. I hope that the non visible and security aspects are well respected. I am still waiting for the reimbursement of my luggage, which is considered unusable and irreparable by the CDG airport service.
reviews.author: Christophe G

reviews.title: Nothing less than scammers
reviews.text: I cannot retain to express my complete dissatisfaction and outrage at the disgraceful behavior of Thai Airways in relation to my refund request for a flight ticket booked in 2019. It is utterly unacceptable that a supposedly reputable airline is resorting to devious tactics to avoid paying their rightful debts. I have provided all the necessary documentation and information, as requested by Thai Airways in the past. However, the airline continues to delay the refund process, asking for the same information repeatedly, wasting my time and causing me great inconvenience. It is incredibly disappointing to see that Thai Airways, a national flag carrier of such a prestigious country as Thailand, is engaging in such unscrupulous behavior. This is nothing short of scamming, and it is unacceptable for any company, let alone an airline with a reputation to uphold. I must inform you that I will make sure that this disgraceful behavior is brought to the attention of the media, as well as other potential customers who may be considering flying with your airline.
reviews.author: Francesco P

reviews.title: Rude staffs!
reviews.text: Thai airways lounge at concourse D, level 3 (main entrance opposite gate D4) Two lady staffs at check in counter 21/04/2023 16:00 I gave passport to them, but i put the previous boarding pass (Hongkong flight) to them as well because not sure whether do they need to check it or not.. then they using terrible words with unkind tone to us. She said “why am i still keep this unwanted boarding pass in here” It make her complicated to check those transfer flights number and name. I still remember untill now “จะเก็บไวเพื่อ” & ทำเสียงลำคาน “madamm I already scan it for youuuu” Which is I understand ALL what she was talking. I didn’t response with this lady. And try to be calm. ❗️NOT RECOMMENDED THAI airways to anyone as I used to do.
reviews.author: Nana

reviews.title: Very disappointing company
reviews.text: Very disappointing company Dirty and old airplane Kindness of the staff on board disappeared Very expensive ticket price
reviews.author: TOM B

reviews.title: Cancelled our flight and tried to refund us with vouchers
reviews.text: They cancelled our flight and they won't refund us cash. We did a chat and they told us they would refund us cash, they didn't. Gave us vouchers. We have called twice, got hung up on twice after an hour hold. We have tried chat twice which just doesn't work. I advise you don't use this airline, the customer service is terrible.
reviews.author: Rin

reviews.title: Good airline
reviews.text: I purchased the ticket online and they were offering a discounted rate for a round trip last year. The ground service was good but check-in process was slow. Good food and entertainment inflight. Crews were good as well.
reviews.author: Dr. Ziauddin Ahmed

reviews.title: Worst Customer Service Experience
reviews.text: The worst customer service ever experienced in our international travel history. It has been 4 months since we have reported and requested damaged luggage claim, but this filthy airlines niether cares to respond nor replies to several emails for settlement. It is shocking and utterly disappointing that such a so called reputed airlines can be immensely rude in conduct to not even bother to reply on e-mails leave alone making good for the loss incurred for their fault and mis-management. However, when we received the said baggage at Mumbai airport on the belt, we found that the baggage was broken with irreparable damage. Soon upon receiving the damaged luggage, we immediately reported the concern to Thai Airways staff member, Ms. Simran who was present there on duty. While, we requested to personally meet a Senior staff member to present the issue, Ms. Simran responded that there was no need to meet anyone since she had already inspected, acknowledged and certified the loss. Attaching herewith a photo of her acknowledgement and inspection receipt. The bag is otherwise new and now the utility of the bag is n
reviews.author: Amrit Thakkar

reviews.title: Good airline and flight
reviews.text: I am a frequent flyer and I was apprehensive to fly with Thai Airways given the recent reviews. However I am happy to report a good experience and everything went very smoothly. The staff on board were welcoming and attentive and the food and drinks sufficient for the 11 hour flight. The IFE had a good selection of films for adults and children. Both flights were on time and there no issues with my luggage.
reviews.author: Paul

reviews.title: Worst airlines!
reviews.text: I took a 9-hour flight from Sydney to Bangkok on March 11, 2023. I specifically purchased a seat with extra legroom as I was traveling with an infant and needed a bassinet. My partner sat behind me. I was informed that I would not be provided a bassinet even though my child met the size requirements because they were 8 months old and not 6 months old. I was stuck in my seat with my baby and unable to even eat. The flight attendant was very rude and told us that if my partner wanted to sit in the empty seat next to me, he would have to pay $120 AUD for a paid seat. I would not have even purchased this seat if I knew I would not be provided a bassinet. As an alternative, the flight attendant offered us worse seats in the back rows, where my partner would also be seated separately. I had an inflatable bed for the baby, which the flight attendant also did not allow me to use. My child had to sit for 9 hours despite not even being able to sit yet and now has a distorted silhouette. I regret purchasing another premium economy flight with this airline before this experience, as it was the worst flight and airline experience of my life, and I will be pursuing legal action. Avoid this airline at all costs!
reviews.author: Kamila Ł
